summary: Dot quet 3: them 123 nguon (LIT-112..LIT-234) cho 12 chu de moi 13-24, nang thu vien tu 111 len 234. Moi nguon deu qua vong kiem may: goi HTTP that tung URL, doi chieu moi DOI voi Crossref/DataCite. 228 nguon mo duoc truc tiep (VERIFIED_URL), 6 nguon bi nha xuat ban chan bot thi xac minh qua DOI metadata va ghi ro gioi han do trong unverified_fields. Khong nguon nao bi loai. Bo sung contracts/literature_reference.schema.json va tests/test_literature_index.py (ca hai da khai trong write_scope tu dau nhung chua bao gio duoc tao). Test moi bat duoc 2 khuyet tat co: LIT-016/LIT-049 trung URL tu dot quet truoc (da khai tuong minh trong duplicate_reference_ids), va README chep tay so lieu dot 1 (55 nguon) trong khi index da 111 - nay sinh lai tu index nen khong the lech.
assumptions: Nguon bi tuong bot chan (HTTP 403/202) van duoc giu neu DOI phan giai dung tieu de o Crossref/DataCite hoac file that tai ve doc duoc; gioi han nay ghi trong unverified_fields cua tung ban ghi.
Bo sinh note Obsidian (tmp/export_literature.py) nam ngoai git (.gitignore), nen phan vault khong tai dung duoc tu Git. Da mo rong bang LABEL/VI cho 12 chu de moi.
